fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. `auto` lets the model choose.

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the generated video. `1080p`, `1440p` (2K) and `2160p` (4K) are finished by the video upsampler; exact dimensions depend on the aspect ratio.

fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds. `auto` lets the model choose.

fields.name: generate_audio
fields.title: Generate Audio
fields.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.

fields.name: safety_tolerance
fields.title: Safety Tolerance
fields.description: The safety tolerance level for the generated video. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.
